text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"); no purpose or field-of-use limitation is stated, supporting commercial use, private use, distribution, and modifications

text: condition 1 (source redistributions must retain the above copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer, without modification, immediately at the beginning of the file); this supports include-copyright and include-license-text, while no mark-modifications or corresponding-source duty is stated
text: condition 1 opening ("Redistributions of source code"); the retention and beginning-of-file notice duties attach to source distribution, while modification alone has no separate trigger

text: condition 2 (the author name may not be used to endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); final disclaimer ("AS IS", express/implied warranty disclaimer, and limitation of liability)

text: complete license text (opening grant, source notice condition, endorsement/name condition, and disclaimer); no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause is stated

text: condition 1 requires retaining the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer without modification immediately at the beginning of every source file; the mandatory placement and unmodified-preservation formula create a material source-notice burden
